metadata.title: Stocks Sell Off After Anthropic Debut

content.text:
Updated 16 hours ago
Stocks Sell Off After Anthropic Debut
Tech stocks' losses deepened after Anthropic's much-anticipated initial public offering today. The Nasdaq and Dow are now both off more than 2%. Some analysts say investors are selling other AI stocks, including AMD, to fund their purchases of the IPO. Here's a look at the stocks that are sliding on Anthropic's first day:
